whatIs.a: A Dark Cave is a text-based incremental survival and settlement game. You wake in a cave with no memory, light a fire, gather resources, build a village, and descend into the dark.

free.a: Yes. You can play for free in your browser at <site>a-dark-cave.com</site>. There are fully optional purchases.

idle.q: Is it an idle or clicker game?
idle.a: No. It is an incremental game that is semi-idle and active. You make choices and manage a settlement. It is not a second-screen clicker.

like.a: If you like A Dark Room, Kittens Game, The Ensign, Universal Paperclips, Candy Box, Level 13, or KEROS-9, this is aimed at that taste. It is not affiliated with them.

phone.q: Can I play on my phone?
phone.a: Yes, in a mobile browser. There is no App Store or Google Play app.

steam.a: Yes. A Dark Cave is coming to <steam>Steam</steam> on 27 October 2026. A <demo>free demo</demo> is available now. The Steam edition is a paid game.

download.q: Do I need to download the browser game?
download.a: No. Play it in the browser.

save.a: Yes. Progress saves automatically in the browser. An optional account adds cloud save.

account.a: No. You can play without one. An account is only for cloud save.

singlePlayer.a: Yes. A Dark Cave is a single-player game.

ending.q: Does the game have an ending?
ending.a: Yes. There is a story, lots of secrets and lore, and more than one ending.

languages.a: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese, and Russian in the browser. Steam also lists Japanese.

help.a: Email <email>support@a-dark-cave.com</email> or ask on the <reddit>A Dark Cave subreddit</reddit>.

about.p1: A Dark Cave is a text-based incremental survival and settlement game. You wake in the entrance of a cave, light a fire, gather what you can, build a village at the threshold, and go back down.
about.p2: Play for free in your browser at <site>https://a-dark-cave.com</site>. <demo>A free Steam demo</demo> is available now. The full Steam release is planned for 27 October 2026.
about.p3: It is built for people who like minimalist incrementals such as A Dark Room, Kittens Game, and Candy Box. It is not a clicker and not a second-screen idle game.
